name: Commodity Contract Management
description:
As a Contract Manager.I want to create a Commodity Contract with the mandatory fields
  So that I can quickly onboard a new supplier agreement without unnecessary data entry.

elements.name: Create Commodity Contract Management with approver.

steps.name: open browser
enter the user name as "username"
enter the user password as "password"
the user should be navigated to the dashboard
user navigates to "Commercial" dashboard sidebar menu
user clicks on "Commodity Contract Management" section on the dashboard page
clicks on "Create" "plus" icon on the Commodity Contract Management dashboard
user selects "Coffee Farmer Purchase Contract" from the "Class" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "FLAT PRICE" from the "Pricing" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Default (DND)" from the "Billing Location" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Default (DND)" from the "Shipping Location" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Season 2026 - 2027" from the "Season" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Transporter (busan)" from the "Counterparty" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Transporter (busan)" from the "Shipper" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "NEW YORK - ARABICA" from the "Exchange" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "SELLER'S CALL" from the "Fixation By" literal dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "Prior to 1st Notice Day" from the "Fixation Terms" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "EUR" from the "Invoice Currency" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "IMMEDIATE" from the "Payment Terms" dropdown in the "General" section
user selects "GST 18%" from the "Tax Structure" dropdown in the "General" section
user fills product details for test case "TC_CCM_002"

steps.name: user selects "DDP" from the "INCO Terms" dropdown in the "Delivery Terms" section
user selects "Re Weights" from the "Weight Terms" dropdown in the "Delivery Terms" section
user enters "Uganda" in "Place" text field in the "Delivery Terms" section
user selects "AB" from the "Abritration" dropdown in the "Delivery Terms" section
user selects "CERTIFICATES REQUIRED FOR ECC" from the "Document Set" dropdown in the "Documents" section
the user selects the "PHYTOSANITARY CERTIFICATE" checkbox under "Document Set"
click on "Save" button
capture "Commercial Commodity" "Contract No."
